description: This file defines the Connection class responsible for managing a database connection within the OrangeHRM installer utilities. It initializes the connection with specific parameters, registers custom type mappings, and provides methods to access and reset the singleton connection instance.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the database connection used during installation, encapsulating connection setup, configuration, and recovery.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection with parameters from the StateContainer and logs system details.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection instance, creating it if it does not exist.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stored connection instance to null, forcing reinitialization on next access.
